key_help_title: How to create a web API key
help.intro: With the desktop app open, items go straight into your local Zotero. Otherwise the Zotero web API is used, which needs a key you create:
help.step1: Open {link} and click Create new private key.
help.step2: Tick Allow library access and Allow write access, then save.
help.step3: Put the key it shows and the user ID from that page into {file}:
help.note: The workbench only reads this file. It never asks for your Zotero password and never takes keys in the interface.
